title: [inductor][NVGEMM] Register vendored epilogue providers
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* #191515
* #191514
* #190825
* #190822
* #192298
* __->__ #190821
* #190820
* #190819

> Add CuTeDSL operator wrappers for the vendored dense and block-scaled kernels. The wrappers define the extended reduction argument ABI, validate supported axes and group geometry, and register block-scaled variants with the provider API. Dense EFC substitution remains in the later NVGEMM selection commit.
>
> Add canonical TensorSSA reduction descriptors and shared materialization for reduction sources, combine operations, and finalizers in `CuteDSLOpOverrides`, allowing both providers to consume the same semantic reduction contract.
>
> Test Plan:
>
> ```bash
> python -m py_compile torch/_inductor/codegen/cutedsl/cutedsl_op_overrides.py torch/_inductor/kernel/vendored_templates/cutedsl/wrappers/dense_blockscaled_gemm_kernel.py torch/_inductor/kernel/vendored_templates/cutedsl/wrappers/dense_gemm_efc_kernel.py
> lintrunner -a
> ```
>
> Authored with an AI assistant.

## Verified Issues

- **[medium] Synthesized widened EFC kernels cannot be resolved by name** — Location: `kernel_cache.py:212-253, 520-535`. Trigger: an upstream dense EFC kernel with `tile_n < 64` lacks an equivalent upstream kernel at a synthesized width. Failure sequence: substitution creates a renamed tile-64/128 kernel, but lookup reverses only the provider name while retaining the synthesized tile size, misses the original kernel, and returns `None`. Impact: a generated kernel choice cannot be restored, breaking later kernel selection or compilation. Reviewers: Claude Design Review, Codex Design Review.

- **[low] Centered-mean feed-main recognition always rejects its successful result** — Location: `nv_universal_gemm_scheduling.py:373-379`. Trigger: a group-of-2–4 centered-mean consumer returns the existing serialized value `"mean_linear:1:-1:0"`. Failure sequence: the unchanged string result is compared with `(1.0, -1.0, 0.0)`, so the function returns `None` and never constructs the feed-main configuration. Impact: the specialized fused lowering is silently disabled for all matching graphs. Reviewers: Claude Bug Review, Codex Bug Review.
